How it works
Upload your data, train your AI agent, customize its style to match your brand, and add it to your website in under five minutes.
Build Your AI Chatbot for free
Request a demo
1. Import Your Data & Train Your AI Agent
Upload your files (PDFs, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets), add your website, or sync directly from platforms like Google Drive, Confluence, and Notion. Botsonic will understand your data and instantly train your AI agent.
2. Customize Behavior & Appearance
Personalize your AI agent’s style with your branding—add logos, choose color schemes, and set the conversational tone to resonate with your brand's unique voice.
3. Embed on Your Website
Effortlessly integrate a custom chat widget into your website to provide instant AI-powered support, tailored to match your site's design.
4. Integrate with Your Tools
Connect your AI agent to services such as WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Slack, Zapier, and more, for a unified, omnichannel experience.
5. Monitor Conversations & Gain Insights
Monitor, track, and analyze your AI Agent's performance with instant insights and real-time performance data to refine strategies, optimize performance, and improve customer satisfaction metrics.

Certificates
SOC 2 Type II
Botsonic is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, demonstrating our commitment to secure data management and adherence to rigorous, verified security protocols.
GDPR Compliant
Botsonic protects your data with secure processing practices and offers tools to exercise your GDPR rights effectively.
HIPAA
Botsonic aligns with HIPAA requirements, ensuring the protection of health information through stringent security measures and compliance practices.
We are Model Agnostic
Botsonic is model-agnostic, i.e., we are not dependent on one LLM provider. Our proprietary AI Model Gateway, called
GPT Router
dynamically routes between multiple AI models, thus speeding up responses and ensuring the best quality output as well as non-stop reliability.
